description: Use only once the customer has decided to buy ("I'll take it", "how do I buy?"): the checkout handoff. Returns the buy_url to give the customer, the final price and a ready-to-send checkout block (next_step, payment_methods, delivery) — on the page they press "Get your Flat" and pay securely. No account needed; the eSIM is delivered on screen and by email within seconds of payment. No in-chat order tracking, no discount codes. For prices while the customer is still comparing, use quote_flat.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

destination.description: Country in ANY language or its ISO code, e.g. "Japan", "Japon", "jp". Map a city to its country first. One country per Flat.

flat.description: Optional: which Flat of the country, as get_flats numbers them. Omit = the cheapest Flat that allows the speed.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

mbps.description: Maximum speed in Mbps (5, 10, 25, 50; default 5). Data is unlimited at that speed. 25 Mbps and up need a 5G network.

networks.description: Optional: operator names from get_flats that must be included (the cheapest Flat holding all of them is used). Ignored when flat is given.

name: start_checkout

buy_url.description: The roamflat card preset to exactly this configuration. Use verbatim.

days.description: Days booked, counted from the first connection in the destination country.

delivery.description: How and when the eSIM arrives.

flat.description: Which Flat of the country (1 = cheapest network only; higher numbers include more networks). Pass it back to quote the same Flat.

message.description: A ready-to-send line for the customer.

name.description: The Flat's name as the shop shows it: "Flat · Vodafone + O2" or "Flat · all 4 networks".

networks.description: Operator names included, as the shop states them.

next_step.description: What the customer does now: open buy_url, press "Get your Flat", pay.

price.description: FULL price of this configuration in currency — the amount paid. Not per day.

price_per_day.description: For comparison only. Never multiply it yourself.

speed_mbps.description: The chosen maximum speed. Data is unlimited at this speed.

title: Start secure checkout
